parts.name: Cap
parts.Basic_description: This is the cap of a USB flash drive, made of plastic, designed to cover and protect the USB connector. It is small and lightweight.
parts.Functional_description: The cap protects the USB connector from dust, moisture, and physical damage when not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It can be detached and reattached manually; it does not move during normal operation.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the USB flash drive, made of plastic, housing the internal memory chip and USB connector.
parts.Functional_description: It contains the electronic components for data storage and provides the interface for connecting to computers or other devices.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, except for insertion or removal from a USB port.
